about: Spellings of one value on the data side: a resource attribute, the body of a GENERAL PIP (subject.paritySpellGen, pinned per request) and a header value (subject.paritySpellHdr, X-Parity-Spell) carry 5 or 'v' as a JSON number, a JSON string, a number inside a string, a list of one, or with whitespace of each class at an end; each paired with the plain value or with its own text.
